author: RealTimeMP Extension
name: RealTimeMP
shortDescription: Complete real-time multiplayer: rooms, player sync, custom events, RPC, chat, lobby — connect to any WebSocket server.

eventsFunctions.description: Connect to a WebSocket multiplayer server.
eventsFunctions.name: Connect

eventsFunctions.description: Disconnect from the server.
eventsFunctions.name: Disconnect

eventsFunctions.description: Create a new room. Optionally add a password and set it as private.
eventsFunctions.name: CreateRoom
eventsFunctions.sentence: Create room named _PARAM1_ max _PARAM2_ players (password: _PARAM3_, private: _PARAM4_)

eventsFunctions.description: Join an existing room by ID. Use the lobby to get room IDs.
eventsFunctions.name: JoinRoom

eventsFunctions.description: Leave the current room.
eventsFunctions.name: LeaveRoom

eventsFunctions.description: Request the list of available public rooms from the server. Use LobbyRoomCount() and LobbyRoomData() to read results.
eventsFunctions.name: RequestLobbyList

eventsFunctions.description: Open an in-game lobby browser UI showing all available rooms. Players can see room names, player counts, and join with one click. Requires an active server connection.
eventsFunctions.name: ShowLobbyUI

eventsFunctions.description: Open the in-game chat UI for the current room. Only works when the player is inside a room. Players can send and receive messages in real time. Call again to toggle/close.
eventsFunctions.name: ShowChatUI

eventsFunctions.description: Send this player's position (X, Y, Z), angle, and custom data to all other players in the room. Use Z for 3D games. Call this every frame.
eventsFunctions.name: SendPlayerState
eventsFunctions.sentence: Send player state X:_PARAM1_ Y:_PARAM2_ Z:_PARAM3_ Angle:_PARAM4_ Data:_PARAM5_

parameters.longDescription: The Z position of the player in 3D space. Use 0 for 2D games.
parameters.name: z

parameters.description: Custom data (JSON string or any string)
parameters.name: customData

eventsFunctions.description: Automatically sync all players in the room every frame. Sends local player state (including Z position) and updates all other players. Toggle animation, flip, scale, and 3D animation sync on/off.
eventsFunctions.name: SyncPlayerFull
eventsFunctions.sentence: Sync players: my object _PARAM1_ ↔ others _PARAM2_ | Anim:_PARAM3_ Flip:_PARAM4_ Scale:_PARAM5_ Anim3D:_PARAM6_

parameters.longDescription: The name of the local player object in your scene (e.g. 'player')
parameters.name: playerObject

parameters.longDescription: The name of the object used to represent other players (e.g. 'OtherPlayer')
parameters.name: otherObject

parameters.longDescription: Enable to sync the current animation index to all other players
parameters.name: syncAnimation

parameters.longDescription: Enable to sync horizontal/vertical flipping (facing direction)
parameters.name: syncFlip

parameters.longDescription: Enable to sync the object scale on X and Y axes
parameters.name: syncScale

parameters.longDescription: Enable to sync 3D model animation name and frame index for 3D objects
parameters.name: syncAnim3D

eventsFunctions.description: Send a custom named event with data to other players. Leave target empty to broadcast to all in room.
eventsFunctions.name: SendCustomEvent
eventsFunctions.sentence: Send event _PARAM1_ with data _PARAM2_ to player _PARAM3_ (empty = all)

eventsFunctions.description: Mark the current custom event as processed and move to the next one.
eventsFunctions.name: FlushCustomEvent
eventsFunctions.sentence: Mark current custom event as handled

eventsFunctions.description: Call a named function on another player's game. Args must be a JSON array string e.g. '[1, "hello"]'.
eventsFunctions.name: CallRPC
eventsFunctions.sentence: Call RPC _PARAM1_ with args _PARAM2_ on player _PARAM3_ (empty = all)

eventsFunctions.description: Mark the current RPC call as processed.
eventsFunctions.name: FlushRPC
eventsFunctions.sentence: Mark current RPC call as handled

eventsFunctions.description: Set a shared room variable visible to all players.
eventsFunctions.name: SetRoomVariable

eventsFunctions.description: Send a chat message to all players in the room.
eventsFunctions.name: SendChatMessage

eventsFunctions.description: Mark the current chat message as read.
eventsFunctions.name: FlushChatMessage
eventsFunctions.sentence: Mark current chat message as read

eventsFunctions.description: Sync an object's state to all players. Only call from host.
eventsFunctions.name: SyncObject
eventsFunctions.sentence: Sync object _PARAM1_ at X:_PARAM2_ Y:_PARAM3_ Angle:_PARAM4_ Data:_PARAM5_

eventsFunctions.description: Kick a player from the room. Only works if you are the host.
eventsFunctions.name: KickPlayer

eventsFunctions.description: Spawn a bullet/object and automatically sync it to all other players with same position, angle, and animation. Call this once when the object is created.
eventsFunctions.name: SpawnSyncedBullet
eventsFunctions.sentence: Spawn synced bullet named _PARAM1_ at X:_PARAM2_ Y:_PARAM3_ Angle:_PARAM4_ Animation:_PARAM5_

parameters.longDescription: The name of the object in your scene to sync.
parameters.name: objectName

parameters.longDescription: The animation to play on the spawned object. Leave empty if not needed.
parameters.name: animation

parameters.description: Bullet object (optional) — pass the just-created bullet object here to automatically tag it with the shooter's player ID (self-hit protection)
parameters.longDescription: If provided, the object's 'pid' variable is set to your own player ID, so it can never register as a hit against yourself.
parameters.name: bulletObject

eventsFunctions.description: Triggered when another player spawns a synced bullet. Use this to create the bullet object in your scene.
eventsFunctions.fullName: On bullet spawned by another player
eventsFunctions.name: OnBulletSpawned
eventsFunctions.sentence: A synced bullet named _PARAM1_ was spawned by another player

parameters.description: Object name to listen for (leave empty for any)
parameters.longDescription: Filter by object name. Leave empty to catch any synced bullet.
parameters.name: objectName

parameters.description: Bullet object (optional) — pass the object you just created for this synced bullet here to automatically tag it with the original shooter's player ID (self-hit protection)
parameters.longDescription: If provided, the object's 'pid' variable is set to the sender's player ID, so collisions can be checked against the true owner.
parameters.name: bulletObject

eventsFunctions.description: Get the X position of the last received synced bullet.
eventsFunctions.name: BulletX

eventsFunctions.description: Get the Y position of the last received synced bullet.
eventsFunctions.name: BulletY

eventsFunctions.description: Get the angle of the last received synced bullet.
eventsFunctions.name: BulletAngle

eventsFunctions.description: Get the animation name of the last received synced bullet.
eventsFunctions.name: BulletAnimation

eventsFunctions.description: Get the player ID who spawned the last received synced bullet.
eventsFunctions.name: BulletSenderId

eventsFunctions.description: Get the value of the pid variable of an object (its RealTimeMP player ID).
eventsFunctions.name: ObjectPlayerId

eventsFunctions.description: Filter the currently picked objects, keeping only those whose existing pid variable matches the given player ID.
eventsFunctions.name: PickObjectByPlayerId

eventsFunctions.description: Self-hit protection: returns true only if the given bullet's owner is NOT the given target, and the target is a real, currently connected player. Add this condition alongside your normal collision condition (e.g. "Bullet is colliding with OtherPlayer AND IsValidBulletHit(Bullet, OtherPlayer)") to guarantee a bullet can never register a hit against its own shooter, a not-yet-synced ghost object, or an already-disconnected player.
eventsFunctions.fullName: Is a valid bullet hit (owner check)
eventsFunctions.name: IsValidBulletHit

parameters.longDescription: The bullet object involved in the collision. Must have been tagged with an owner pid (via Spawn synced bullet / On bullet spawned, or manually).
parameters.name: bulletObject

parameters.longDescription: The player object the bullet collided with (e.g. OtherPlayer). Must have a pid variable (set automatically by Sync players (full auto)).
parameters.name: targetObject
